billing_runs_calculation_check.name: billing_runs_calculation_check
billing_runs_calculation_check.value: ("billing_runs"."calculation_snapshot" IS NULL AND "billing_runs"."subtotal_minor" IS NULL) OR ("billing_runs"."calculation_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "billing_runs"."subtotal_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "billing_runs"."usage_snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL)

adjustments_value_check.name: adjustments_value_check
adjustments_value_check.value: "customer_billing_adjustments"."amount_minor" IS NOT NULL OR "customer_billing_adjustments"."quantity" IS NOT NULL

plans_amount_check.name: plans_amount_check
plans_amount_check.value: ("plans"."base_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "plans"."base_amount_minor" >= 0) AND ("plans"."additional_minute_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "plans"."additional_minute_amount_minor" >= 0) AND "plans"."number_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "plans"."channel_amount_minor" >= 0

plans_quantity_check.name: plans_quantity_check
plans_quantity_check.value: "plans"."included_numbers" >= 0 AND "plans"."included_channels" >= 0 AND ("plans"."included_minutes" IS NULL OR ("plans"."included_minutes" >= 0 AND "plans"."included_minutes" <> 'NaN'::numeric))

subscriptions_dates_check.name: subscriptions_dates_check
subscriptions_dates_check.value: ("subscriptions"."current_period_start" IS NULL AND "subscriptions"."current_period_end" IS NULL) OR ("subscriptions"."current_period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "subscriptions"."current_period_end" IS NOT NULL AND "subscriptions"."current_period_start" < "subscriptions"."current_period_end")

usage_snapshots_value_check.name: usage_snapshots_value_check
usage_snapshots_value_check.value: "usage_snapshots"."provider_cost_minor" IS NOT NULL OR "usage_snapshots"."provider_cost_exact" IS NOT NULL OR "usage_snapshots"."usage_quantity" IS NOT NULL

usage_snapshots_numeric_check.name: usage_snapshots_numeric_check
usage_snapshots_numeric_check.value: ("usage_snapshots"."provider_cost_minor" IS NULL OR "usage_snapshots"."provider_cost_minor" >= 0) AND ("usage_snapshots"."provider_cost_exact" IS NULL OR ("usage_snapshots"."provider_cost_exact" >= 0 AND "usage_snapshots"."provider_cost_exact" <> 'NaN'::numeric)) AND ("usage_snapshots"."usage_quantity" IS NULL OR ("usage_snapshots"."usage_quantity" >= 0 AND "usage_snapshots"."usage_quantity" <> 'NaN'::numeric))
